LONG-TERM OUTLOOK

1-, 3- & 5-year price predictions

Automatic, speculative scenarios based on project merit, adoptability and tokenomics. Base estimates are illustrative judgments, not statistically estimated expected prices. No settings or inputs required.

What drives these estimates

Forecast method & uncertainty

Each horizon runs forward from the displayed quote. Starting implied market cap = price × circulating supply, which can differ from the vendor’s reported market cap. Future cap = starting implied cap × (1 + merit contribution + adoption contribution)years. Future price = future cap ÷ assumed future supply.

Growth contributions and dilution rates are editorial scenario choices, not fitted to historical returns or validated by a predictive model. Project sources support descriptions, not our price targets. Supply assumptions are shown above; most are illustrative because complete unlock schedules are unavailable. Refreshing prices updates the anchor, not the research assumptions.

Downside and upside subtract or add 35 percentage points to annual market-cap growth, holding modeled supply constant. These are stress scenarios, not confidence bounds or probabilities. Actual outcomes can lie outside the range, including complete loss. Five-year estimates compound more uncertainty than one-year estimates. Privacy scores and GitHub push times are not used as return predictors.

Methodology, coverage & limitations

Quotes, supply, volume and history come from CoinGecko. The bundled snapshot is a fallback; refresh makes public API requests from your browser. Rate limits or browser/network restrictions may prevent updates. Every quote retains the provider timestamp. Quotes older than one hour are marked stale. Reported volume is not executable liquidity or order-book depth.

Privacy scores are provisional editorial judgments on a 0–10 ordinal scale, not measurements or probabilities. We weigh concealment of sender, recipient and amount, transaction linkability, mandatory versus optional privacy, and documented limitations. They assess native-asset transfers, not exchange accounts, bridges or every application.

Scale: 0 = no transaction privacy; 1–3 = limited mixing or network protection with exposed ledger data; 4–6 = meaningful confidentiality with major linkability gaps; 7–8 = broad protections with opt-in use or substantial design/validation caveats; 9 = broad default protection with residual risks. No asset receives 10, which would overstate certainty. Differences of one point are subjective. Ratings are not independent code audits; source links and the reason appear in each asset’s detail. “Not rated” means insufficient verified evidence, not zero privacy. Coverage is shown above.

Price charts use positive UTC-midnight daily provider samples; they are not exchange-specific candle closes.

Privacy classifications are editorial summaries, not audits. Unreviewed assets stay in the comparison with unknown protocol/roadmap fields. Live supply is not an independently audited unlock schedule. This app does not provide revenue, cash flow, verified fees or staking APY for all projects. Forecasts use disclosed editorial growth and supply assumptions for reviewed projects. They are speculative scenarios without assigned probabilities; unreviewed assets have no numeric forecast.

Market data and research are provided by external sources. This application does not execute trades. An immutable Ootle testnet record stores the saved research edition’s fingerprint and URL; research content and refreshed prices remain off-chain.
